name: Dank – Velvet Vampire – 7pk Preroll
shortDescription: Hybrid · 30.6% THC · Seven ready-to-light prerolls with a dark, berry-sweet profile
description:
Dank Velvet Vampire is a hybrid built for people who want potency and flavour in the same smoke. Every pack holds seven evenly rolled prerolls filled with Velvet Vampire flower testing at 30.6% THC, so each one delivers a consistent, full-strength session without any grinding or rolling on your part.

The aroma opens with deep dark berry and sweet grape, followed by a soft, earthy spice that lingers on the exhale. The smoke is smooth and rich, with a velvety mouthfeel that gives the strain its name. Buds are ground to an even consistency and packed carefully, which means a slow, steady burn with no canoeing and no harsh hot spots.

The effects arrive as a balanced hybrid high. A warm wave of euphoria and mood lift comes first, clearing away stress and putting you in a relaxed, sociable headspace. As the session goes on, a gentle body calm settles in that eases tension without locking you to the couch. It suits evenings with friends, movie nights, or simply winding down after a long day.

The 7-pack format makes it easy to share around a group or keep a few on hand for the week. Each preroll is sealed inside its packaging to stay fresh until you are ready to light it.

Because Velvet Vampire tests above 30% THC, newer smokers should start with a few puffs and wait before having more. Store the pack in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight, and keep it out of reach of children and pets.

name: Her Highness – Hoe Hoe Hoe (Infused) – 5pk Preroll
shortDescription: Sativa-dominant infused · 38.8% THC · 0.99% CBD · Five prerolls, 2.5g total
description:
Her Highness Hoe Hoe Hoe is an infused, sativa-dominant preroll pack made for experienced smokers who want an elevated, high-energy experience. The pack contains five prerolls with 2.5g of material in total, and the infusion pushes potency to 38.8% THC with 0.99% CBD for a strong yet well-rounded effect.

Her Highness is known for stylish, carefully crafted prerolls, and this limited release keeps that tradition going. Premium flower is blended with concentrate to raise the strength and deepen the flavour, then rolled in slim papers that are easy to carry and quick to light. Each preroll burns evenly from tip to finish.

Expect a bright, uplifting sativa high. The first few draws bring a rush of energy, focus and good mood that works well for creative projects, social gatherings or getting out and about. The small amount of CBD helps round off the edges, giving a clear and cheerful buzz rather than a racy one. The flavour leans sweet and festive, with light citrus and spice notes on the exhale.

The five-pack size is perfect for sharing with friends or spreading out over several sessions. Each preroll stays protected inside the packaging so it smokes as fresh as the first.

This is an infused product with very high THC, so it is not recommended for beginners. Take one or two puffs, wait a few minutes, and only continue once you know how it affects you. Store in a cool, dry place and keep away from children and pets.

name: Electraleaf – Medusa – 5pk Preroll
shortDescription: Sativa · 26.59% THC · Five clean-burning prerolls with an energising lift
description:
Electraleaf Medusa brings a bold, clear-headed sativa experience in a convenient five-pack of prerolls. Each preroll is filled with Medusa flower testing at 26.59% THC, giving you a reliable, energising smoke whenever you want it.

Electraleaf focuses on clean, consistent prerolls, and Medusa shows that care. The flower is ground evenly and packed to the right density, so every preroll lights easily and burns slow and steady. The smoke is smooth on the throat, with a sharp, refreshing aroma of citrus and fresh herbs and a slightly sweet, earthy finish.

The effects are classic sativa. A quick, cerebral lift sharpens your focus and lifts your mood, making Medusa a strong pick for daytime use, creative work, outdoor activities or social plans. Many smokers find it keeps them alert and talkative rather than sleepy, with a light body feel that does not weigh you down.

The five-pack format is ideal for sharing or for keeping a few ready for the week ahead. Each preroll is protected inside the packaging to hold onto freshness and flavour.

At over 26% THC, Medusa is potent, so newer smokers should start slowly and see how they feel before having more. Store the pack in a cool, dry place away from sunlight, and keep it out of reach of children and pets.

name: Electraleaf – Purple Haze – 5pk Preroll
shortDescription: Sativa · 26.29% THC · A legendary classic in five ready-to-smoke prerolls
description:
Electraleaf Purple Haze brings one of cannabis culture's most famous strains to a ready-to-smoke five-pack. Each preroll is filled with Purple Haze flower testing at 26.29% THC, offering the bright, uplifting sativa high that has made this strain a favourite for decades.

Purple Haze is known for its sweet, berry-forward flavour with hints of earthy spice and a light floral finish. Electraleaf grinds the flower evenly and packs each preroll with care, so you get a smooth, flavourful smoke and a slow, even burn every time you light up.

The effects are energetic and inspiring. A wave of euphoria lifts your mood and gets ideas flowing, making it a great companion for music, art, conversation or a sunny afternoon. The high stays clear and upbeat, with just enough body relaxation to keep you comfortable without slowing you down.

This pack suits anyone looking for a classic sativa with strong flavour, cultural history and a cheerful, creative buzz. With five prerolls inside, it is easy to share with friends or save some for later, and each one stays fresh inside the packaging.

At over 26% THC, Purple Haze is strong, so start with a few puffs and give it time before having more. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight, and keep out of reach of children and pets.

name: Electraleaf – Cream Smoothie – 1g – Preroll
shortDescription: Hybrid · 25.64% THC · A single 1g preroll with a sweet, creamy finish
description:
Electraleaf Cream Smoothie is a full-gram hybrid preroll made for a smooth, balanced, flavour-rich session. It is filled with Cream Smoothie flower testing at 25.64% THC, delivering a satisfying effect in one easy, ready-to-light joint.

As the name suggests, Cream Smoothie is all about flavour. The aroma is sweet and creamy, with notes of vanilla, soft fruit and a gentle earthy base. The smoke is mellow and smooth, leaving a pleasant, dessert-like taste on the exhale. Electraleaf grinds the flower evenly and packs the full gram carefully, so it lights cleanly and burns slowly from start to finish.

The effects sit right in the middle of the hybrid spectrum. Expect an easy-going lift in mood and a calm, clear head, followed by a light, soothing relaxation through the body. It is versatile enough for an afternoon with friends or a relaxed evening at home, and it works well for unwinding without feeling overly heavy.

The single 1g format is perfect for trying a new strain, sharing one between friends, or keeping a preroll on hand for the right moment. It comes sealed to stay fresh until you open it.

At over 25% THC, take it slowly if you are new to cannabis. Store in a cool, dry place, follow local recycling and waste guidelines for the packaging, and keep it out of reach of children and pets.

name: MFNY – Electric Lime x Lemon Cane Live Resin – 4pk Preroll
shortDescription: Sativa · Live resin infused · Four prerolls bursting with bright citrus flavour
description:
MFNY Electric Lime x Lemon Cane is a live resin infused sativa preroll pack made for true connoisseurs. The pack holds four prerolls that pair premium flower with live resin concentrate for richer flavour, stronger effects and a smoother, longer-lasting burn.

Live resin is extracted from fresh-frozen plants, which keeps far more of the original terpenes than standard concentrates. The result is an intense, true-to-strain citrus profile: zesty lime and bright lemon up front, with a sweet, candy-like finish from the Lemon Cane side of the cross. Every draw tastes fresh and vibrant.

The effects are clean and energising. A fast, uplifting rush sharpens your focus and lifts your mood, making this pack a great choice for daytime sessions, creative work, social plans or outdoor adventures. The live resin infusion gives the high extra depth and staying power, while the sativa genetics keep it clear-headed and upbeat.

MFNY is known for bold, high-quality infused prerolls, and each one in this pack is rolled to burn evenly from tip to finish. The four-pack size makes it easy to share or to spread across a few sessions, and every preroll stays protected inside the packaging.

Is this product suitable for beginners? Because of its potency, newer smokers should start slowly, or try a non-infused preroll first. Take a puff or two and wait before having more. Store in a cool, dry place and keep out of reach of children and pets.

name: Anthem Bold – Pineapple Haze – Wood Tip Infused – 1g Preroll
shortDescription: Sativa-leaning · Infused · A 1g wood tip preroll with tropical pineapple flavour
description:
Anthem Bold Pineapple Haze is an infused 1g preroll finished with a premium wood tip, built for a smooth, flavourful and seriously potent smoke. Anthem Bold pairs quality flower with concentrate to boost strength and flavour, then rolls it into a single full-gram joint that is ready to light.

The wood tip is more than a style choice. It keeps the end of the preroll firm, cool and comfortable to hold, and it gives a cleaner draw from the first puff to the last. Combined with an even grind and careful packing, it means a slow, steady burn without the soggy or collapsing tip you get with regular filters.

Pineapple Haze is known for its bright tropical flavour. Expect juicy pineapple and sweet citrus up front, with a light hazy spice in the background. The infusion deepens those flavours and keeps them going throughout the session.

The effects lean towards the sativa side: an energetic, euphoric lift that brightens your mood and gets you talking, laughing and moving. It is a great pick for daytime plans, social gatherings or creative sessions when you want to stay upbeat and engaged.

This is an infused preroll, so it hits harder than standard flower. Start with a few puffs and wait before having more, especially if you are new to infused products. Store in a cool, dry place away from sunlight, and keep out of reach of children and pets.

name: Find Preroll – Cherry Patties – 1g
shortDescription: Hybrid · A 1g preroll with sweet cherry flavour and smooth, easy effects
description:
Find Preroll Cherry Patties is a full-gram preroll that keeps things simple: premium flavour, smooth effects and no guesswork. It comes ready to light, so you can enjoy quality flower without grinding, rolling or fuss.

Cherry Patties is loved for its sweet and tangy profile. The aroma bursts with ripe cherry and candied fruit, backed by a creamy, slightly earthy base that rounds out each draw. The smoke is soft and easy on the throat, leaving a pleasant fruity taste behind. Each preroll is packed with evenly ground flower for a steady, even burn from tip to finish.

The effects are smooth and balanced. A gentle wave of euphoria lifts your mood and loosens you up, followed by a calm, comfortable relaxation that settles through the body. It is relaxing without being heavy, which makes it a good fit for an evening with friends, a quiet night in, or unwinding after work.

The single 1g size is ideal for trying something new, sharing between two, or keeping one in your pocket for the right moment. It is sealed in its packaging to keep the flower fresh and full of flavour until you are ready.

If you are new to cannabis, start with a few puffs and give it time before having more. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight, and keep out of reach of children and pets.
